excluded_rendered_char_ranges.text: **Image-only PDFs are an explicit unusable state.** A scanned/image-only PDF is reported as `no usable text layer (scanned image; needs OCR)`; it is never a quiet empty success. Exit codes stay: all files unusable → 2, mixed usable + unusable → 3 (good candidates keep their own identity). Run OCR/vision separately for those files; the script adds no OCR engine. Each page also carries `raw_text` (unfiltered page text); the resume-platform watermark heuristic only filters the display `text`/`lines`, so legitimate evidence is never erased from the record.

Claim contract (checked before extraction): each item must be a JSON object; `file` and `quote` must be nonempty strings; `page` is optional and must be a positive JSON integer — `true`, `2.0`, `\"2\"` and `0` are rejected. Contract violations fail with exit 2 and a per-claim `index`/`field`/`reason` diagnostic, never a traceback.
This step is semantic and cannot be automated:
